title: SGHateCheck: Functional Tests for Detecting Hate Speech in Low-Resource Languages of Singapore
benchmark_measurement: Detection of hate speech directed at religious groups. Religion is included as one of the 'protected groups' for evaluating the performance of hate speech detection models.
findings: Models performed best at detecting hate speech against Muslims (highest F1 score of 0.532), while Buddhists were among the lowest-scoring targets within religious categories, indicating potential areas for model improvement.
